findings.evidence: `pkg/util/misc.go:414` only sets `mysql.GeneratedColumnFlag` when `isTiFlashStore && c.IsVirtualGenerated()` (`pkg/util/misc.go:423`). `pkg/table/tables/tables.go:1974` builds `tipb.PartitionTableScan.Columns` via `util.ColumnsToProto(..., isTiFlashStore=false)`, so virtual generated columns won’t get the flag. This path is exercised specifically for TiFlash dynamic partition prune: `pkg/planner/core/plan_to_pb.go:258` -> `partitionTableScanToPBForFlash` -> `tables.BuildPartitionTableScanFromInfos` (`pkg/planner/core/plan_to_pb.go:295`). The flag is documented as required for TiFlash placeholder behavior: `pkg/parser/mysql/type.go:79` (“TiFlash will check this flag and add a placeholder…”). Regression vs first parent: previously `convertToTableScan` added the flag for TiFlash scans (`559f634^:pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go:2461-2466`), which would have covered both `TableScan` and `PartitionTableScan` PB builds because they reused the mutated `ColumnInfo.Flag`.
findings.fix: Propagate TiFlash-ness into `BuildPartitionTableScanFromInfos`: either (a) add an `isTiFlashStore bool` parameter (mirroring `BuildTableScanFromInfos`) and pass `true` from `partitionTableScanToPBForFlash`, then call `util.ColumnsToProto(..., isTiFlashStore)`; or (b) if `tipb.PartitionTableScan` is TiFlash-only by design, change `pkg/table/tables/tables.go:1974` to pass `true` for `isTiFlashStore`.
findings.impact: On TiFlash with dynamic partition pruning (partitioned tables, MPP/batch-cop), scans involving virtual generated columns may miss TiFlash’s required placeholder columns, leading to runtime errors (column count/type mismatch) or incorrect column mapping/results.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Not fixed on `upstream/master` as of `3b531d4e3d`: `upstream/master:pkg/table/tables/tables.go:1866` still passes `isTiFlashStore=false` in `BuildPartitionTableScanFromInfos`, and the TiFlash dynamic partition prune path still calls it (`upstream/master:pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop/physical_table_scan.go:685-736`).
findings.verify: Unit-level: construct a `tipb.PartitionTableScan` for a table containing a virtual generated column and assert the corresponding `tipb.ColumnInfo.Flag` includes `mysql.GeneratedColumnFlag` when building for TiFlash. Integration-level: partitioned table with virtual generated column + `tidb_isolation_read_engines='tiflash'` + dynamic partition prune enabled; run `SELECT gen_col FROM t` and ensure no TiFlash execution error and correct results.
findings.what: TiFlash `PartitionTableScan` PB construction fails to set `mysql.GeneratedColumnFlag` for virtual generated columns after the store-type check was pushed down into `util.ColumnToProto`, because `BuildPartitionTableScanFromInfos` hardcodes `isTiFlashStore=false`. This can break TiFlash placeholder-column behavior on the dynamic partition prune path.

subject: planner/core: pushdown TiFlash store type check to ColumnToProto (#55463)
summary: High-risk regression: TiFlash dynamic-partition `PartitionTableScan` still builds column protos with `isTiFlashStore=false`, so virtual generated columns lose `GeneratedColumnFlag` and TiFlash may not add required placeholder columns.
